sentence: This project builds an imaging method that maps and separates two effects that turn light into current in very small photodetectors.
This project studies how the resurrection fern protects and reorganizes its genetic material during dehydration and rehydration.
This project studies how a plant's genetic diversity shapes the microorganisms in the rhizosphere and how these affect the plant during drought stress.
This project sets up a research center that studies the design, operation and maintenance of land-based and offshore wind energy systems.
This project studies how water, solutes and colloids move through fractures in rock, using imaging to watch the flow.
This project measures the exchange of volatile organic compounds between farmland and the atmosphere and studies their contribution to aerosol production.
This project builds a degree program in cybersecurity that combines coursework and research.
This project studies how toxins and immunity proteins help Ralstonia compete against other plant-colonizing bacteria.
This project sets up a nanoscale 3D printer that makes custom micro- and nanoscale structures for research.
This project studies how climate change affects Arctic rivers, their fish and the communities that rely on them.
This project tries to map regions that keep providing stable ecosystem services despite climate change.
This project builds algorithms that reconstruct how a diffusion process spread through a network from partial observations.
This project collects and describes yeasts from plant, animal and environmental samples and studies whether they evolved together with their animal hosts.
This project studies how positive interactions between freshwater species change with environmental conditions, traits and scale.
This project uses methods inspired by homological mirror symmetry to answer open questions in algebra and geometry about polynomial rings.
This project studies how mechanical systems can learn to recognize patterns in the way neural networks do.
This project builds algorithms and software that let any seismologist analyze very large seismic datasets.
